ignoreValues.reason: Design decision: Space Grotesk is used only as the body/content face (user-typed event names, player names, forms, descriptions), never as a display face — the pixel display faces (Silkscreen/Press Start 2P) carry all of the app's own fixed chrome labels instead. Operate-mode guidance (craft-floor.md) explicitly permits workhorse/system sans faces for body content; kept as the pre-existing incumbent body font for continuity.
